req.title: Create new player
req.statement: The system shall create a player and respond with HTTP 201 when POST /players/ receives a valid Player payload.
expected_outcomes: Location header points to new resource

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates HTTP 201 on POST /players/ with a valid payload, a Location header pointing to the new resource, and appropriate 4xx/5xx on error paths. Tests cover: (1) EP positive — valid full payload yields 201 + correct Location + correct response body fields; (2) NEG — missing required field yields 422; (3) NEG — duplicate squad_number yields 409; (4) BVA — squad_number boundary at minimum integer 1 (already exists) vs a new unique value; (5) DT — optional fields absent still yields 201; (6) BVA — empty string for required string field yields 422. Each test asserts exact status codes and exact header/body values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_full_payload_returns_201_with_location
preconditions: Database pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows (squad numbers 1-26)
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a complete valid PlayerRequestModel payload using squad_number=99
expected: Response body contains id (UUID), firstName='Test', lastName='Player', squadNumber=99, position='Goalkeeper'
trace: R-PLAYER-006: system shall respond HTTP 201 when POST /players/ receives valid payload
R-PLAYER-006: Location header points to new resource
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_valid_full_payload_returns_201_with_location():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "middleName": "Middle",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper",
        "abbrPosition": "GK",
        "team": "Test FC",
        "league": "Test League",
        "starting11": False
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert "Location" in r.headers
    assert r.headers["Location"] == "/players/squadnumber/99"
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert body["abbrPosition"] == "GK"
    assert body["team"] == "Test FC"
    assert body["league"] == "Test League"
    assert body["starting11"] == False
    assert "id" in body
    import uuid
    uuid.UUID(body["id"])

test_post_player_valid_full_payload_returns_201_with_location()

tests.name: test_post_player_location_header_exact_format
actions: Inspect Location header for exact path format
expected: Location header is exactly '/players/squadnumber/50' (not a full URL, not a different path)
trace: R-PLAYER-006: Location header points to new resource
EP: verifies exact Location header format as set by player_route.py
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_location_header_exact_format():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Location",
        "lastName": "Check",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Centre-Forward"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    location = r.headers.get("Location")
    assert location is not None
    assert location == "/players/squadnumber/50"
    assert location.startswith("/players/squadnumber/")
    assert location.endswith("/50")
    assert "http" not in location

test_post_player_location_header_exact_format()
